workflow: Reference-led Higgsfield Scene Builder / Blender authoring; not automatic image-to-3D reconstruction.

coordinateSystem.axes: glTF Y up; X east/right; Z south/front. Rear is negative Z.
coordinateSystem.localToWorld: world = local + proposedRootWorld; no rotation or scale
coordinateSystem.note: Local Y0 is the existing sea level, not the workshop walking floor. Local XZ0 is the territory centre, not the proposed asymmetric bounding-box centre.

workshop.authoringHeightNotice: The existing building authoring contract records historic world Y18.06. Actual runtime Y is1.66; local building geometry and the27 local hulls are unchanged.
workshop.nativeTerrainNotice: The current terrain is not a perfectly flat32x26 clearing. Flattening it in a future terrain asset would be a genuine new height revision, not preservation of this baseline.

transfers.note: Cannon is an additional existing solid, separate from the workshop27. No boat dock or jetty belongs to Projects.

preservationBaseline.seedRisk: WORLD_PROPS calls getShoreRadius and rejects against seeded paths/decks/hulls. Changing the current radius/clearance functions changes RNG consumption and coordinates. Isolate the historical placement geometry or retain the actual poses explicitly before a future reshape; do not accept a new hash as proof of preservation.
preservationBaseline.heightRisk: Prop JSON storesXZ/scale/yaw, not groundY. A matching props hash does not prove unchanged height, palm crown clearance, rock contact or collision after reshaping.

proposedAuthoringOnly.role: Bare continuous terrain/bedrock study; all buildings, bridges, cannonequipment and vegetation remain separate assets.
proposedAuthoringOnly.envelopeNotice: Asymmetric bounding envelope relative to the retained map centre; not a rectangular shore. Its small east/south offset accommodates both real landing collars inside60x56 without moving anchors. Current terrain58.8338x59.0036 and this60x56 study are different geometry.
proposedAuthoringOnly.clearingPolicy: Broad worn sand/earth apron, not a new slab or uniform raised disc. Retain the30x24 workshop floor at localY4.86 and all27 hulls. Feather apron into real low coastal ramps; do not extend its flat height to the coastline.
proposedAuthoringOnly.highlandPolicy: Three unequal joined eroded shoulders behind the workshop. Their support frontmostZ is−16.5 or less, outside the clearing/deck and all existing pedestrian/transit approaches. Smooth mineral volumes and turf crowns, not disconnected boulder piles or upper walking platforms. Exact centres/heights are proposed design dimensions, not reconstructed measurements from bitmaps.
proposedAuthoringOnly.propConflictNotice: Several preserved rear palms/rocks/shrubs lie within these proposed supports. Do not merge or silently delete them in the bare master. Later integration must reconcile their real ground height, trunk/crown/rock geometry and collision against the new surface; no unchanged prop-height claim is made.
proposedAuthoringOnly.shorePolicy: Front-left shallow sand cove, smaller front-right sandy inlet and offset right promontory. Connected broad bedrock reaches the seabed; its support is submerged, never an exposed pedestal or tapered floating underside. The generated images are cliff-heavy and tilted; correct these explicitly rather than treat them as metric orthographic geometry.

protectedLandingCollars.policy: Both true oriented collars must be solid connected terrain at the existing measured landing heights, with the current bridge top0.06m below land. A bounding-box fit alone is not a supported-entry proof. Keep the full5.5m/3.5m inward approach corridors unobstructed and walkable without jumping.

integrationGateRequired: Review actual GLB POSITION geometry, bounds, textures/materials, normals, zero-area faces and front/right/top orthographic renders; bitmap similarity is not acceptance.
Reconcile an actual terrain mesh with getTerrainHeight/territoryAt/isWalkable, Rapier trimesh, render geometry and coast/ocean sea-contact field; no unseen floor or art-only walkable land.

Retain all four bridge/transfer endpoint contracts, the workshop30x24 floor, all27 workshop hulls, separate cannon and five station/approach anchors; rerun actual Rapier walks in both directions with unchanged controller.
Preserve all196 seeded poses and21 station records by their historical placement source/hash; separately verify new groundY, trunk/crown/rock contact and supported transfer arrivals.
Treat Projects height/outline as an explicit new revision if mounted. Keep the other five terrain baselines and existing71 foundation contracts unchanged unless separately authorised and tested.
Rerun foundation contact, camera/overview, world/coast/ocean checks, lint/build and scoped browser failure/recovery/reading/input checks; no inheritance of old passing counts.
proposedAuthoringOnly.acceptanceBoundary: Only a dimensional modelling proposal. No generated or mounted island, physics support, reference fidelity, artistic acceptance, frame-rate measurement or deployment is certified.
